method.vad: audio-vad-cpu: 16kHz mono, 20ms frames, calibrated lower-quintile noise floor, 220ms hangover, 120ms minimum
method.onsets: two generator profiles (mean/max) with backtracking, clustered within 70ms; fixed median profile kept as independent judge
method.promotion: generate against mean/max+VAD consensus, then repair only outliers against a fixed median onset judge within 160ms; preserve lanes, holds, timeChanges and audio
method.strict_gate: at least two of four independent timing methods support >=90% of note timestamps within 80ms; individual judge metrics, VAD coverage and native Audio Sync Test/mobile playtest remain separate
